scope: 76 mapped worlds; Canon identity and broad environmental references. Not a certification of artwork, exact geography or complete story appearances.
method: Read Wookieepedia Canon planet index and individual articles using the user’s Chrome browser. Moon identities checked separately. Secondary-source findings are attributed to Wookieepedia; cited books were not independently inspected.

worlds.name: Tatooine
worlds.appearance: Sand, rocky bluffs, canyons and mountains
worlds.note: Hot arid world; no broad oceans in the orbital treatment.

worlds.name: Alderaan
worlds.note: Terrestrial world; remove gas bands. Coastlines and mountain placement remain illustrative.

worlds.name: Yavin 4
worlds.note: Yavin 4, not the red parent gas giant Yavin Prime.

worlds.name: Hoth
worlds.appearance: Ice plains, glaciers, mountains and frozen seas
worlds.note: Frigid; avoid exposed temperate land.

worlds.name: Dagobah
worlds.appearance: Swamps, bogs, jungle and heavy fog
worlds.note: Hot humid atmosphere; surface visibility limited by cloud and mist.

worlds.name: Bespin
worlds.appearance: Gas giant with extensive cloud layers
worlds.note: No conventional solid surface; breathable life stratum does not describe the whole atmosphere.

worlds.name: Coruscant
worlds.note: Historical mountains/oceans must not become modern exposed continents.

worlds.name: Mandalore
worlds.appearance: Desert and domed cities; later glass, crystals and storms
worlds.note: Era-dependent. Do not blend historical forests, pre-Purge deserts and post-Purge devastation without a label.

worlds.name: Endor (forest moon)
worlds.note: Forest moon; the index's Endor planet is a separate gas giant.

worlds.name: Ferrix
worlds.appearance: Salvage areas, cities, mountains, mesas and oceans
worlds.note: Industrial sites are local; do not infer an entirely industrial globe.

worlds.name: Aldhani
worlds.note: Temperate; the atmospheric Eye is a distinct event, not permanent global lighting.

worlds.name: Niamos
worlds.note: Terrestrial coastal world, not a gas giant.

worlds.name: Kenari
worlds.note: Breathable appearance-era atmosphere and later reported toxicity require an era/source qualifier.

worlds.name: Ghorman
worlds.note: Local settlement imagery is not planet-wide urban coverage.

worlds.name: Mina-Rau
worlds.note: Farmland motif; no measured global land-water fraction established by this review.

worlds.name: Chandrila
worlds.note: Temperate; preserve distinction from city-covered Coruscant.

worlds.name: Dantooine
worlds.appearance: Grasslands, forests, mountains, rivers and oceans
worlds.note: Mixed terrestrial terrain rather than a single jungle texture.

worlds.name: Christophsis
worlds.note: Crystalline geography; city layouts and crystal placement remain illustrative.

worlds.name: Teth
worlds.appearance: Jungle lowlands, towering mesas and mist
worlds.note: Purple/mauve atmospheric appearance; planet described as Wild Space, unlike atlas system-region label.

worlds.name: Ryloth
worlds.appearance: Deserts, jungles, mesas, valleys and volcanoes
worlds.note: Mixed terrain; do not import Legends-only global climate assumptions.

worlds.name: Geonosis
worlds.note: Rocky desert world; orbital rings are separate from surface bands.

worlds.name: Nevarro
worlds.note: Settlements change across eras; no uniformly molten globe implied.

worlds.name: Sorgan
worlds.appearance: Conifer forests, grasslands, wetlands and lakes
worlds.note: Wet agricultural habitat; do not turn the whole globe into an ocean.

worlds.name: Corvus
worlds.appearance: Forest, foothills and damaged cracked ground
worlds.note: Calodan-area damage is local; avoid a globally dead-forest claim.

worlds.name: Tython
worlds.appearance: Forests, grasslands, mountains and a polar ice cap
worlds.note: Keep K-10: individual article explains the newer placement versus the list's older L-10.

worlds.name: Morak
worlds.appearance: Rainforests, mountains, rivers and freshwater archipelagos
worlds.note: Warm terrestrial world.

worlds.name: Maldo Kreis
worlds.note: Frigid terrestrial world.

worlds.name: Aleen
worlds.appearance: Desert plains, rocky mesas, isolated forests and underground caverns
worlds.note: Separate breathable surface air from the non-oxygen underworld; underground light is not orbital surface color.

worlds.name: Anaxes
worlds.note: Intact Clone Wars world is distinct from later Fort Anaxes debris. Individual article agrees with Outer Rim; index says Core.

worlds.name: Bardotta
worlds.appearance: Cold mountains, highlands, plains and ice caps
worlds.note: Use varied cold terrain; an interior hall is not evidence of global appearance.

worlds.name: Balnab
worlds.note: Temperate; local unusual growth does not establish global coverage.

worlds.name: Cato Neimoidia
worlds.appearance: Acidic oceans, cliffs, canyons, forests and rock arches
worlds.note: Bridge cities are local structures; avoid an entirely dry-rock globe.

worlds.name: Dathomir
worlds.appearance: Rocky forests, swamps, rivers and waterfalls
worlds.note: Red atmospheric styling must remain distinguished from mapped vegetation coverage.

worlds.name: Devaron
worlds.appearance: Jungles, deep valleys, low mountains and rivers
worlds.note: Temperate-to-tropical terrestrial world.

worlds.name: Felucia
worlds.note: Distinctive vegetation does not establish measured orbital colors or global patterns.

worlds.name: Florrum
worlds.note: Hot dry terrestrial world.

worlds.name: Ilum
worlds.appearance: Glaciers, ice plains, mountains and shallow seas
worlds.note: Era-dependent excavation and Starkiller conversion must not be silently mixed into pristine Ilum.

worlds.name: Iego
worlds.note: Rocky terrestrial environment; avoid treating nearby moons as surface detail.

worlds.name: Kadavo
worlds.note: Volcanic does not automatically mean a globally glowing lava surface.

worlds.name: Karthon
worlds.note: Prison moon; correctional yards are a local setting, not a global junk coating.

worlds.name: Kessel
worlds.appearance: Barren northern mines and lush southern areas
worlds.note: Preserve hemispheric environmental contrast; exact boundaries are not established here.

worlds.name: Kiros
worlds.note: Temperate green terrain; no measured ocean fraction.

worlds.name: Lola Sayu
worlds.appearance: Volcanic terrain, hills, mountains and caves
worlds.note: Keep distinctive purple orbital treatment; northern breathable atmosphere is not a global guarantee.

worlds.name: Malastare
worlds.note: Temperate; local mauve ground is not a verified global palette.

worlds.name: Maridun
worlds.note: Do not assign Maridun's grasslands to Quell after the evacuation sequence.

worlds.name: Mon Cala
worlds.note: Ocean world; keep separate from generic forest-world treatment.

worlds.name: Mustafar
worlds.appearance: Lava, obsidian mountains and ash; later regrowth
worlds.note: Era-dependent; volcanic Imperial-era depiction is not every historical state.

worlds.name: Moraband
worlds.note: Arid barren treatment; no invented lush continents.

worlds.name: Naboo
worlds.appearance: Wetlands, hills, plains, mountains and cities
worlds.note: Terrestrial mixed environment; invented coastlines are not canonical maps.

worlds.name: Nal Hutta
worlds.note: Hutt Space is an overlapping political/geographic designation, not a contradictory planet identity.

worlds.name: Onderon
worlds.note: Temperate; preserve jungle surrounding settlement areas.

worlds.name: Pantora
worlds.note: Replace the draft's ice-world treatment; Pantora is not icy parent Orto Plutonia.

worlds.name: Rodia
worlds.note: Hot humid terrestrial environment.

worlds.name: Rugosa
worlds.appearance: Dry coral forests and rocky caverns
worlds.note: Former oceans have dried; coral is not evidence of present global tropical seas.

worlds.name: Saleucami
worlds.appearance: Arid/temperate terrain, deserts, swamps, mountains and oases
worlds.note: Mixed environments; do not force a uniformly dry texture.

worlds.name: Serenno
worlds.appearance: Forests, mountains, plains, savannah and sea
worlds.note: Mixed terrestrial terrain.

worlds.name: Scipio
worlds.note: Cold terrain; banking architecture is local.

worlds.name: Toydaria
worlds.note: Temperate wetlands; Hutt Space and Mid Rim labels can overlap.

worlds.name: Umbara
worlds.appearance: Dense vegetation, jungle and plains in dim atmospheric conditions
worlds.note: Distinct dark-world atmosphere; do not interpret darkness as absent vegetation.

worlds.name: Vanqor
worlds.note: Temperate; underground crystals do not establish a crystal-covered globe.

worlds.name: Yerbana
worlds.note: Green-topped cliffs and cloud are local visual cues; no measured coverage.

worlds.name: Zygerria
worlds.note: Temperate terrain; city architecture is local.

worlds.name: Abafar
worlds.note: Pale desert treatment; avoid repetitive gas bands.

worlds.name: Adelphi
worlds.note: Coastal base appearance is not an exact globe map.

worlds.name: Arcana
worlds.note: Local pale ruins do not establish planet-wide city coverage.

worlds.name: Bothawui
worlds.note: Canon article explicitly calls it a gas giant, citing Galactic Atlas; the draft's unknown-composition restriction needs updating.

worlds.name: Carlac
worlds.appearance: Snowy plains, mountains, forests and blue-sand deserts
worlds.note: Cold mixed environment; not exclusively ice.

worlds.name: Corellia
worlds.appearance: Forests, jungles, oceans and industrial cities
worlds.note: Do not render industry across the entire globe.

worlds.name: Lothal
worlds.appearance: Prairies, savannah, rock formations, mountains and inland seas
worlds.note: Era-sensitive industrial damage and recovery; preserve open plains.

worlds.name: Lotho Minor
worlds.appearance: Junk mountains, caverns and polluted terrain
worlds.note: Hot with acid rain; salvage identity is distinct from a natural rock world.

worlds.name: Oba Diah
worlds.note: Dark rocky world; moon and planet remain separate identities.

worlds.name: Quarzite
worlds.appearance: Dense grey cloud layer with violet flashes
worlds.note: Canon article supplies orbital description. Keep underground crystals separate; static violet accents avoid flashing effects.

worlds.name: Seatos
worlds.note: Red forest styling is distinct from lava; no invented surface map claims.

worlds.name: Segra-Milo
worlds.appearance: Rocky expanses, cliffs, mountains and caverns
worlds.note: Segra Milo / Segra-Milo are spelling variants; green-brown overhead appearance does not establish dense forest.

worlds.name: Quell
worlds.appearance: Terrestrial world with blue atmosphere and extensive white cloud
worlds.note: Physical class is terrestrial; surface terrain remains unresolved. Keep clouded visual treatment rather than inventing continents.

worlds.name: Ringo Vinda
worlds.appearance: Orbital globe; specific surface terrain not established in reviewed article
worlds.note: The encircling structure is an artificial graving dock, not natural planetary bands.
